events.text: Six crews and aircraft were detached as an advance party to Parry Island, Eniwetok.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 25 June 1945 : Six crews and aircraft were detached as an advance party to Parry Island

events.text: The remainder of the squadron joined the detachment at Parry Island.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The remainder of the squadron joined the detachment at Parry Island on 30 June 1945

events.text: VPB-22 was transferred back to Saipan.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 7 August 1945 : VPB-22 was transferred back to Saipan

events.text: An advance party of six aircraft proceeded to Chimu Wan, Okinawa.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 9 August an advance party of six aircraft proceeded to Chimu Wan , Okinawa

events.text: The remainder of the squadron arrived and shifted to quarters aboard USS Cumberland Sound.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The remainder of the squadron arrived on by 19 August and shifted to quarters aboard the recently arrived USS Cumberland Sound

events.text: The squadron moved from Cumberland Sound.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 16 August the squadron moved from Cumberland Sound

events.text: The squadron commenced operations from Chimu Wan, Okinawa.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 1 September 1945 : The squadron commenced operations from Chimu Wan , Okinawa

events.text: These operations were halted when the squadron was relocated to NAS Sangley Point, Philippines.
events.subject: self
events.quote: These operations were halted on 16 September , when the squadron was relocated to NAS Sangley Point , Philippines

events.text: The squadron moved temporarily to the Philippines.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 23 September 1945 : USS Norton Sound had steamed ahead to Sasebo , Japan , when the squadron moved temporarily to the Philippines

events.text: VPB-22 flew to the harbor of the former Imperial Japanese Navy base at Sasebo.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On the 23rd , VPB-22 flew to the harbor of the former Imperial Japanese Navy base at Sasebo

events.text: Squadron personnel were shifted to the tender.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On the 28th , squadron personnel were shifted to the tender

events.text: The squadron was transferred to the operational and administrative control of FAW-18.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 30 September 1945 , the squadron was transferred to the operational and administrative control of FAW-18

events.text: The squadron was recalled to NAS Kaneohe Bay.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 1 December 1945 : The squadron was recalled to NAS Kaneohe Bay

events.text: All hands departed for NAS San Diego for rest and rehabilitation leave.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Transportation was arranged by 5 December , and all hands departed for NAS San Diego

events.text: VPB-22 was reformed at NAS San Diego for training and duties as a ferry command.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 20 January 1946 : VPB-22 was reformed at NAS San Diego for training and duties as a ferry command

events.text: VP-MS-2 was transferred to for seaplane handling, plane refueling, arming and towing training.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 3 February – 28 April 1947 : VP-MS-2 was transferred to for seaplane handling

events.text: The same training evolutions were carried out aboard.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 28 April , the same training evolutions were carried out aboard

events.text: The squadron began a split deployment to Buckner Bay, Yokosuka and Tsingtao.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 20 October 1947 – 30 April 1948 : The squadron began a split deployment to Buckner Bay , Okinawa ; Yokosuka , Japan ; and Tsingtao , China

events.text: The administrative command relocated to Tanapag Harbor, Saipan.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 27 February 1948 , the administrative command relocated to Tanapag Harbor , Saipan

events.text: The squadron returned to NAS San Diego under the operational control of FAW-14.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The squadron returned to NAS San Diego on 30 April 1948 , under the operational control of FAW-14

events.text: VP-42 departed NAS San Diego for NAF Iwakuni, Japan.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 14 July 1950 – April 1951 : VP-42 departed NAS San Diego for NAF Iwakuni , Japan

events.text: Upon arrival the squadron was immediately transferred to NAF Yokosuka.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Upon arrival on the 19th , the squadron was immediately transferred to NAF Yokosuka

events.text: The squadron returned to NAF Iwakuni.
events.subject: self
events.quote: At the end of August 1950 the squadron returned to NAF Iwakuni

events.text: The deployment ended in April 1951.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 14 July 1950 – April 1951 : VP-42 departed NAS San Diego for NAF Iwakuni , Japan
